name: Brie wrapped in prosciutto & brioche
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical brioche-wrapped Brie recipes (serves 6 as a side/appetizer).
Total time sums explicit steps: 10 min mixing + 6 hrs refrigeration + 1 hr 30 min chilling/proofing + 22 min bake; excludes optional final resting.
Allergens based on listed ingredients only; 'to glaze' egg adds to egg allergen.
Dairy from milk, butter, Brie; wheat from plain flour; prosciutto confirms non-vegetarian.
instructions:
Mix the flour, 1 tsp salt, caster sugar, yeast, milk and eggs together in a mixer using the dough attachment for 5 mins until the dough is smooth. Add the butter and mix for a further 4 mins on medium speed. Scrape the dough bowl and mix again for 1 min. Place the dough in a container, cover with cling film and leave in the fridge for at least 6 hrs before using.
Wrap the Brie in the prosciutto and set aside. Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured surface. Roll into a 25cm circle. Place the wrapped Brie in the middle of the circle and fold the edges in neatly. Put the parcel onto a baking tray lined with baking parchment and brush with beaten egg. Chill in the fridge for 30 mins, then brush again with beaten egg and chill for a further 30 mins. Leave to rise for 1 hr at room temperature. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6, then bake for 22 mins. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: Plain Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Standard plain white wheat flour, dry weight as listed.

ingredients.name: Yeast
ingredients.assumptions: Standard active dry yeast; 7 g sachet weight used.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Whole cow's milk, as listed; typical density applied.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 3 large whole eggs ≈ 50 g edible portion each (shells excluded); total edible weight.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 1 additional large egg beaten for glaze; ≈ 50 g edible portion used for brushing the entire parcel twice.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Unsalted butter, as incorporated into the dough.

ingredients.name: Brie
ingredients.assumptions: Standard 250 g wheel of Brie cheese; fully edible.

ingredients.name: Prosciutto
ingredients.assumptions: 8 typical thin slices of prosciutto ≈ 10 g each (total 80 g); fully edible cured ham.
